title: Trim the mustaches and let the beards grow
hadeeth: Ibn ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Trim the mustaches and let the beards grow."
explanation:
The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) enjoins that the mustache should be trimmed and not be left to grow; rather, it should be cut, and this should be done to a great extent.

On the other hand, he enjoins that the beard should be left to grow long.
hints: The prohibition of shaving the beard.
hadeeth_intro: Ibn ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said:
hadeeth_ar: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: «أحْفُوا الشَّوَارِبَ وأَعْفُوا اللِّحَى».
hadeeth_intro_ar: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال:
explanation_ar:
يَأْمُرُ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالأخْذِ مِن الشَّارِبِ وألَّا يُتْرَكَ بل يُقَصّ منه، ويُبالَغ في ذلك.

وفي المقابل يَأمر بإِعفاءِ اللحية وتركِها مَوْفُوْرة.
